definition_prose: AVG_MATCH is the observed mean number of winning main numbers matched per native ticket across every eligible draw in the artifact's evaluation window. Computed by lottolab.research.base_method_evaluation as the exact rational total_main_hits / total_native_tickets. Descriptive only: this definition commits no ranking direction, threshold, admission gate, or significance claim. The hypergeometric random reference and delta the evaluator computes alongside this value are evaluator-internal comparison semantics and are deliberately not persisted as separate metric results.
